audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Neeko / Neeko / Skill x5. The packet chart, the page's own whys (which describe Mordekaiser winning 2 through first item) and the already-audited mirror all say Neeko / Mordekaiser x5 / Neeko. Also full:diff was 'HARD' while diffRating 4/10, the green tone, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t all say 'Favoured' — the header contradicted its own rating.
audit.why: Death's Grasp (E, 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls Neeko into Obliterate's single-target bonus damage while Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s, stores damage into a shield he can consume as a heal) undoes her chip. She has no answer until items let her kite a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Neeko, Levels 2 through first item Mordekaiser, 2+ items Neeko — proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings. diff set to FAVOURED to match its own 4/10.

audit.why: spikes[] has all four entries and the timings are right: Neeko's Level 1-2 range advantage, his Level 3-5 pull window, his Level 6 Realm of Death, and Neeko's 2+ item kite spike. The mirror confirms the 2+ items row is Neeko's teamfight spike.
audit.corrected: Left the spike timings; realigned full:phases[N].why to state the same spikes the content layer already states.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability claims were wrong. (a) dosFull[2] told the player to 'Save E to interrupt Realm of Death' — nothing in Riot's text makes Realm of Death a channel and the kit carries no channel flag, so a root interrupting it is unverified. (b) dosFull[2].d called Realm of Death's cooldown 'fifteen-second'; it is 140/120/100s. (c) tradeBad, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d all warn about 'a mobile champion' and 'whiffing it into a dash' — Mordekaiser has no dash at all, which is the single most important fact about fighting him after items.
audit.why: A player told to hold a 12s root to interrupt a 140s ultimate will hold it every wave and never trade; a player told Morde is mobile will never learn the kite that actually wins the game.
audit.corrected: E is held for Death's Grasp (16s rank 1, 8s rank 5), not for the ult. Realm of Death is a 140s cooldown at rank 1 — that is the invitation. Mordekaiser has no dash: once you have items you kite a body that must walk into 675 range to do anything. Also: Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade — Oblivion Orb belongs in the first back.
